ruling.explanation:
To the rider and the driver: this ruling concerns trip TRP-02827 (pickup Blk 108 Yishun Ring Rd, dropoff Blk 112 Ang Mo Kio Ave 4, 29 Aug 2026).

DISTANCE AND DEVIATION (POL-RD-01). The governing measurement is the GPS trace. EV-GPS-02827 records trace_distance_km 14.4 against the booked optimal of 9.0 km on EV-TRIP-02827 — an excess of 5.4 km, which is 60.0% of optimal. Both establishment tests pass (60.0% > 20% and 5.4 km > 0.8 km) and the excess also clears the 50% materiality gate, so a MATERIAL route deviation is established on this trip's own evidence. The trace itself is clean for policy purposes — 114 fixes at a 10 s interval, no gaps, max_gap_sec 0.0, 100% coverage — so POL-RD-07(a) to (c) is not met, no independent corroboration is required, and POL-RD-10(3) does not fire. Both advocates' agreement on this point is accepted.

NO ADJUSTMENT TO THE EXCESS. The chat log EV-CHAT-02827 contains 0 messages, so there is no rider instruction and POL-RD-04 is unavailable; the trip record shows null amendment timestamps and a null amended optimal, so POL-RD-05 cannot be run; vehicle_type is RYDE_X, not RYDE_POOL, so POL-RD-12's pooled baseline does not apply. The driver's explanation, 'Road works.', names no advisory evidence ID, and the bundle's only traffic advisory, EV-ADVIS-02827-01, is MISSING with weight_multiplier 0.0 (issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT), so POL-RD-03 cannot be run and the assertion carries no weight under POL-RD-08. Because the driver cited no advisory identifier, POL-RD-13(1) keeps this out of POL-RD-10(5): an assertion that cites no artifact cannot be invoked against one, so the case does not escalate on that ground. I have weighed the driver's traffic excuse and rejected it as unsupported on this record; the excess stands at the measured 5.4 km / 60.0%.

THE FARE ARITHMETIC. On the METERED model (quoted_fare_sgd is null, so POL-RD-11 does not apply), POL-RD-02 computes recomputed_fare = (3.80 base fare + 0.75 x 9.0 km + 0.28 x 13.0 min) x the 1.0 surge multiplier read from EV-FARE-02827, plus the 0.80 platform fee = 14.99. Charged_total is 20.66, giving a POL-RD-02 refund of 5.67, rounded UP to 5.70. Both advocates agree on this figure and it is correct; I record it as the base figure.

THE REMEDY UPLIFT (POL-RD-06). The driver profile EV-DPROF-02827 shows deviation_flags_90d of 3 and completed_trips_90d of 180. The clause establishes a pattern when deviation_flags_90d is 3 or more OR the ratio is 0.05 or more with at least 40 completed trips. Three flags meets the first limb outright, so a repeat pattern is ESTABLISHED. I reject the driver advocate's argument that the 0.0167 ratio defeats the test: the clause's two limbs are alternatives, not cumulative, and the 'permissive' reading of limb (b) is not what the clause says — the three effects listed are what follow once the pattern is established. Because the deviation here is both MATERIAL and substantiated on this trip's own trace, POL-RD-06(b) upgrades the remedy from the POL-RD-02 partial to FULL_REFUND of charged_total. No ERP, toll or airport surcharge line exists to be settled separately under POL-RD-09 (tolls_erp 0.00, airport_surcharge 0.00, erp_gantries empty), so the whole charged_total is uplifted. Side by side: the POL-RD-02 figure is 5.70; the uplifted POL-RD-06(b) figure is 20.66. The uplift is a remedy uplift only — the finding of deviation rests on this trip's trace alone, not on the driver's history, and POL-GEN-01 is respected: only deviation_flags_90d and completed_trips_90d were used, and prior_deviation_flags (5) is a lifetime counter that grounded nothing.

OTHER LINES. EV-FARE-02827 itemises no ERP gantries, no airport surcharge, no cancellation fee and no fixed surcharges, and its lines reconcile to the 20.66 charged, so POL-RD-09 adds nothing and no billing-integrity correction or referral arises. EV-RPROF-02827 shows deviation_claims_60d 0, so POL-RD-08's serial-claimant corroboration enhancement is not in play.

OUTCOME. Full refund of the contested amount: SGD 20.66 to the rider (the POL-RD-02 base figure of SGD 5.70 is recorded above for audit). Under POL-RD-06(c) the case is additionally referred to driver-conduct review; that referral rides with the money and does not displace or delay it. Confidence is 0.90 — the cap is the minimum weight among the artifacts carrying the deciding facts, and EV-GPS-02827, EV-TRIP-02827, EV-FARE-02827 and EV-DPROF-02827 are each at weight 1.0. The monetary effect of SGD 20.66 exceeds the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so this provisional ruling is issued but not executed automatically: the amount is held for release by a human reviewer. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

The judge was asked 4 times on the same inputs and every draft agreed on this ruling, so it is carried unanimously (vote agreement 1.00).
